Product Features

  • LED Coffee Table: The coffee table with LED light strips offers 29 lighting modes that can be controlled by app, creating different moods from cozy evenings to lively gatherings. This modern LED coffee table meets all your lighting needs.
  • Coffee Table with Storage: Our coffee table has a spacious open storage space and side storage compartments where you can neatly organize and store all your essentials to keep your space free of clutter.
  • High-gloss coffee table: The surface of the modern coffee table is smooth and glossy, with a smooth lacquer finish that is not only aesthetically pleasing but also waterproof, scratch-resistant and easy to clean, enhancing the décor of your living room.
  • Stable structure: This coffee table is made of high-quality chipboard with a high-gloss finish, which ensures durability, easy maintenance, and smooth, quiet movement of the drawers. It is durable, stylish and easy to clean.
  • Easy assembly and after-sales service: To make assembling this sturdy coffee table as easy as possible, we've included clear and detailed instructions as well as numbered parts. If your item is damaged, scratched or missing a part, please contact us.
  • Smart Storage: With a spacious cabinet, our coffee table for the living room provides ideal storage space for essentials, from magazines to playground equipment, keeping things organized. And the open shelf makes it easy to reach for the remote control or phone when needed.
  • Sipp, snack and share: Our rectangular coffee table has a spacious shelf for snacks and drinks - ideal for meeting or playing with loved ones. The glass top in the middle increases the attractiveness of the table and at the same time allows the light to flow into the room.
  • Brighten up your living space: Brighten up your home with our glass coffee table with multi-colored LED lights controlled by app. Adjust the brightness, sync with your favorite songs, and enjoy Bluetooth for an immersive experience.
  • Tempered glass: An attractive place to display collectibles, hero figures, and artwork. A glass coffee table protects items from dust and damage while being easy to clean and maintain. A coffee table with integrated lighting is the ideal choice to improve the look.
  • A wooden coffee table with cabinet provides hidden storage for books, magazines and remote controls. This coffee table with storage allows easy access to the stored items and retains its elegant appearance when closed.
